issues: Document is an 'Область аккредитации органа инспекции' (inspection body scope), not a lab test-range table: there is no numeric range/показатель column, so range_from/range_to/unit are null on every row and 'indicator' holds the inspection type (Отбор проб / Гигиеническая оценка / Санитарно-эпидемиологическая(ое) экспертиза, обследование, расследование) while norm_doc merges the two source document columns (requirements + methods). No ТР ТС section headings exist anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null on every row per the rules (address/location headings and 'Орган инспекции типа А' / 'Пищевая продукция:' / 'Непищевая продукция:' labels are structural headers, not ТР ТС sections). Cover page lists 10 site addresses (item 10, ул. Ангарская 13б литер Ж, is marked '(архив)'), but the table body only contains sections for 9 of them (address 10/archive has no corresponding inspection-scope table); this is transcribed as printed, not an omission by the transcriber. Minor per-address variations were found and transcribed exactly as printed rather than assumed identical: address 3 (Гражданская, 10) includes an extra МР 4.2.0220-20 in the 'предприятия общественного питания' расследование row; addresses 3 and 4 include extra 'Санитарно-эпидемиологическое расследование' sub-rows for some 'Общественные здания' items (5.2/5.3/5.4/5.5) that other addresses lack; address 4 additionally has a unique item 5.6 'Организации, осуществляющие медицинскую деятельность'; addresses 6, 7 and 8 list only one method document (МР 3.1/2.5.0172/4-20) for the transport-object 'обследование' row instead of two; address 5's transport-object 'обследование' row shows '-' in the methods-document cell on the source page. For address 9 (Калач-на-Дону), the transport-object 'обследование' row's methods-document cell fell exactly at a page break (p.43/44) and its content was not visible in the rendered page, so norm_doc for that one row reflects only the two requirement documents (МР 3.1/2.1.0201-20, МР 3.1/2.5.0172/4-20) with no separate methods document merged in, rather than guessing its value. All pages were legible; no illegible text was encountered.
